transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I’m just tired all the time. By midmorning at work, even if I’m only reviewing claim files or walking a junior adjuster through something, I feel like my body and my brain are already running on empty.
When you wake up in the morning, do you usually feel rested?
Not really. I wake up and it doesn’t feel like I’ve gotten my energy back. Even by midmorning at work, just going through claim files or helping someone with a claim, I feel worn out already.
Are you having trouble sleeping at night?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I go to bed, but I haven’t paid close attention to whether I’m actually having trouble sleeping or if I’m just not feeling rested.
Do you find yourself getting so sleepy during the day that you struggle to stay awake?
I don’t think so. I feel drained and worn down during the day, but I wouldn’t say I’m fighting to keep my eyes open or anything like that. I haven’t really noticed that happening.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yes. Most days I feel pretty down, like there’s this gray film over everything. Even when my husband is being kind or we’re cooking with the family, I can go through the motions, but I don’t really feel the enjoyment like I used to.
Have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty?
I’m not sure I’d call it worthless. I do blame myself sometimes, or feel like I should be handling things better, but I don’t know if it’s excessive guilt. It’s just… hard to tell.
Have you been feeling this down most days for at least two weeks?

Yes. It’s been most days for at least that long. I keep feeling like there’s this gray film over everything, and even when I’m with my husband or cooking with the family, I’m mostly just going through the motions instead of really enjoying it.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve had thoughts of actually hurting myself, but… the “life isn’t worth living” part, I don’t know. I guess I’d have to think about what counts.
Have you been thinking that you would be better off dead?
I’m not sure. I don’t sit there thinking, “I’d be better off dead,” exactly. It’s more that I feel worn down and discouraged, but I haven’t really thought it through in those words.
Before this current stretch, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed most days for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had rough patches before, but I don’t know if I’d say it was depressed most days for two full weeks. I’d have to think about it.
Have you noticed your appetite has gone down lately?
I haven’t really noticed my appetite going down, no. It seems about the same, I think.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yes, I have. At work I’m missing details in audits that I normally would catch, and it’s taking me longer to sign off on files. Outside of work, I’ve kind of pulled back from painting, hiking, and volunteering. I’m mostly just trying to get through the week.
Before this recent period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed most days for at least two weeks?
I’m still not sure. I’ve had times where I felt low, but I can’t clearly say it was most days for two weeks or more before this.
Have you had moments lately when you wished you would not wake up?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve had that exact thought, at least not clearly. I’ve felt really worn down, but I can’t say I’ve been wishing I wouldn’t wake up.
Lately, have you been having trouble falling asleep or staying asleep?
I haven’t really noticed a clear pattern with that. Some nights are better than others, but I’m not sure I’d say falling asleep or staying asleep has been a big issue lately.
Before this current stretch, was there ever a time in your life when you felt down nearly every day for two weeks or longer?

I think this current stretch is the main one I can describe clearly. Most days now it feels like there’s this gray film over everything. Even when my husband is being kind, or we’re cooking with the family, I can go through it, but I don’t really feel the enjoyment like I used to.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual lately?
I haven’t really noticed that, no. I don’t think anyone’s said I’m talking slower or moving slower. I may feel a bit sluggish sometimes, but I’m not sure it shows that way.
Before this current period, did you ever have another time in your life when you felt depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I don’t have another specific time I can point to before this and say, yes, that was two weeks or more nearly every day. This current period is the one that stands out to me.
Did this start after a major stress in your life?

Yes, it seemed to start after I was moved into a higher-responsibility role at work. I had to mentor other adjusters and oversee new workflow systems, and since then it’s been going on for about three years and a few months now.
For the past two years, have you felt down or depressed on more days than not?

Yes. For the past couple years, most days I’ve felt down, like there’s a gray film over everything. Even when my husband is being kind, or we’re cooking with the family, I can go through the motions, but I don’t really feel the enjoyment like I used to.
